baseline_B0: tag i occupies X_i with source-lineage multiplicity 1 and current event-state START

carrier_readout.V_relation: declared commuting channel V retained from frozen R059D carrier semantics
carrier_readout.aligned_tags: X_i=H^(q*i) X_0 on declared H orbit of order q*N

controller_visibility: controller reads only its own current relational/event state plus declared exact local count signature; it never reads B/P/deltas
hold_semantics: HOLD/NO_MOVE is not a transition event; packet and current event-state remain unchanged

local_count_semantics.C_i(x): exact source-lineage CPBC multiplicity for tag source i, excluding independent other-tag/scheduler Cartesian factors
local_count_semantics.L(x): sum_i C_i(x), exact local source-lineage count at packet x
local_count_semantics.S(x): number of tag sources i with C_i(x)>0, exact local source-support/cooccupancy count
local_count_semantics.cartesian_global_history_weight: diagnostic only and never a controller input in positive rules

perturbed_P0: differs only by one frozen F-I1/F-I2/F-I3 intervention

schedulers.S_ALL_ORDERS_SNAPSHOT: action sets frozen from current snapshot; all orders of eligible transitions retained; source-local C_i,L,S boundary states are order-invariant while global Cartesian multiplicity may differ
schedulers.S_SYNC: all action sets evaluated from current snapshot; every allowed transitioning lineage executes synchronously
